verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that Poke can 'extract and visualize' data from shared images of spreadsheets to create tables/charts, which is a narrow slice of the story. There is no documentation of direct document or PDF upload, parsing, or accurate content analysis for knowledge-worker use cases. Missing for 10: explicit PDF/document upload support, evidence of accuracy on structured/text-heavy files, and any hands-on validation of analysis quality.
